limitations: The legacy package did not preserve separately verifiable raw HTTP response bytes.
The historical response-body SHA recorded in metadata cannot always be recomputed from the legacy package.
Comments, embedded media, dynamic state, login-only content, and inaccessible material may be absent as recorded in the legacy capture log.
preservation_policy: This correction is additive and external. No legacy package file was edited, deleted, renamed, or replaced.

role_corrections.comments.json: collection-scope record; an empty/not-collected value is not evidence that the source had no comments
role_corrections.source.html: decoded-or-normalized response representation; not guaranteed byte-identical to the HTTP body
role_corrections.source.md: derived visible-text reading layer; does not replace the captured response representation
